company.name: VVIP
company.shortDescription: VVIP provides entertainment experiences and social interactions enabling users to participate in live events and lifestyle activities.
company.description: VVIP is a platform focused on curated entertainment experiences and event-based social interactions, where users can discover and participate in live events and lifestyle activities. It operates as a social and media-oriented service that connects event organizers and audiences through digital tools for promotion and engagement. The company supports functions such as event discovery, ticketing, and content sharing related to entertainment and live experiences. Its services are used across different regions and are aimed at simplifying how users find and interact with events in the entertainment space. The platform also integrates digital and technology-based features to manage and distribute event-related content and user interactions.
